entries.name: 10 random relics will be settled from all 15 relics for a single match
entries.detail: Relic Pool: Weaponsmith, Wheel of Wonder, Leafy Essence, Magic Box, Greevil Egg, Gaoler’s Master Key, March of the Beasts, Mango Tree, Chiaroscuro Certainty, Malefic Rapture, Doubloon(New!), Time-Space Replica(New!), Magic Seed(Comeback), Shroud of Concealment(Comeback), Second Chance(Comeback), Stolen Vault(Special Choice!)

entries.name: A special choice of Stolen Vault is provided instead of Discard in the relic box. A bag of random 10 ~ 20 gold will be dropped as a Stolen Vault
a relic can only be settled once, but can be replicated by Time-Space Replica. Stolen Vault can also be replicated
Recruiting Probability Table slightly changed as follows
Dismiss
entries.detail: Price counts only pieces in chess pool, Pandaren, Undead and unrevealed Legendary pieces not included.

entries.name: Doubloon
entries.detail: New coming! <Relic Consumable: Click to Use> Transfer 20% of the higher one of your Health and Mana into another. Can be used twice.

entries.name: Time-Space Replica
entries.detail: New coming! Replicate your last relic. P.S. A random relic will be settled if it is your first relic, and this randomed one will not be counted as used (still available later). P.S. Time-Space Replica is not in the relic random pool when you random a relic.

entries.name: Stolen Vault
entries.detail: New coming! A special choice of Stolen Vault is provided instead of Discard in the relic box. A bag of random 10 ~ 20 gold will be dropped as a Stolen Vault. If you are not interested in any of the 3 relics in the relic box, just get this Vault! P.S. Can be replicated by Time-Space Replica.
